turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress document to floor]
    C --> D[Name evaporated content]
    D --> E[Locate operative sentence]
    E --> F[Report ratio, erosion, and missing rough edge]
    F --> G[Output ASSAY finding]
    G --> H[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt| I{Mode stated or inferable?}
    I -->|No| J[Ask for mode]
    J --> K[Wait for answer]
    K --> I

    I -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| L[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    L --> M{Floor passes?}

    M -->|No| N{How many gaps?}
    N -->|Three or fewer| O[Ask one question naming gaps]
    N -->|Four or more| P[Ask three largest gaps]
    P --> Q[Assume the remaining gaps]
    O --> K
    Q --> K

    M -->|Yes| R[Compress prompt]
    R --> S{Cut removed specification?}
    S -->|Yes| T[Name decorative or destructive cut]
    T --> U[Revert to last passing version]
    U --> R

    S -->|No| V{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    V -->|No| W{Floor still passes?}
    W -->|No| U
    W -->|Yes| R
    V -->|Yes| X[Declare contract minimal]

    X --> Y[Output optimized prompt and Cut line]
    Y --> Z{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}

    Z -->|Keep negotiating| R
    Z -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| AA{Execution tools available?}

    AA -->|No| AB[Gate stays closed]
    AA -->|Yes| AC[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    AC --> AD{Result}
    AD -->|Success| AE[Done]
    AD -->|Floor failure| AF[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    AF --> R
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: U -> R, AF -> R
